name: Corner lip lift

card.summary: Surgical skin excision at the corners of the mouth to raise downturned commissures; evidence is surgeon case experience, and visible scarring is a recognised risk.
card.aka: Corner of the mouth lift, commissure lift, smile lift
card.note: Scarring at the mouth corner, asymmetry and under-correction are documented risks; published evidence is mostly surgeon series.

quick.overview:
A corner lip lift is a surgical procedure in which a small piece of skin is removed at or just above the corner of the mouth so that downturned corners sit higher. It is sometimes called a smile lift. It is often performed together with an upper lip lift, and some surgeons describe it as a way to widen the visible lip.

On looksmax.org, users discuss it as a way to change mouth proportions and make lips look fuller or the smile more prominent. Published literature consists mainly of surgeon-authored descriptions and case series; no controlled trials were found.
quick.mechanism: Skin is excised in a lens or triangle shape above the oral commissure and the wound is closed, which pulls the corner upward. Some variants also involve the muscles around the mouth. Reports describe the result as a change of a few millimetres.
quick.risks: Reported risks include visible scarring, hypertrophic scarring, asymmetry, under-correction, stiffness, numbness and distortion of the smile. A surgeon-authored review states that lip lift design is more complex than most practitioners realize. Some posters on looksmax.org say surgeons advised against the procedure for aesthetic reasons.

lead: A corner lip lift (also called corner of the mouth lift, commissure lift or smile lift) is a surgical procedure that raises the corners of the mouth, typically by removing a small, lens-shaped piece of skin at or above the oral commissure [1][2]. It is performed to alter the resting angle of the mouth in people whose corners turn downward, and is often combined with an upper lip lift [2].

Plastic surgery literature on the technique is largely descriptive. A 2022 article in the Aesthetic Surgery Journal by authors who reported over 2,440 consecutive lip lifts discusses when to add a corner lift to a deep-plane upper lip lift [2]. Wikipedia notes that surgeons report high satisfaction but that no single lip lift technique has become standard [1].
Within looksmaxxing communities, the corner lip lift is discussed in terms of mouth width, lip fullness and facial proportions, alongside jaw and chin procedures [3][4].

paras: Wikipedia's lip lift article describes four surgical categories: direct (gull-wing) lifts, indirect lifts, corner-of-the-mouth lifts and V-Y advancement. The corner procedure targets the commissures, in one variant by excising a lens-shaped area of white skin around the upper oral commissure [1].
The surgeons behind the CUPID technique describe the corner lift as a design element to be added when appropriate to maintain balance of the upper lip and exposure of the lateral vermilion [2].

No controlled trials of corner lip lift were found. Published material consists of a 2022 surgeon-authored review and technique paper covering a series of more than 2,440 consecutive lip lifts, rated by its authors as level 4 evidence, which concentrates on upper lip design and when to add a corner lift [2]. A 2014 systematic review noted on Wikipedia found philtrum length decreases with indirect lift techniques but not V-Y advancement [1].

Wikipedia's lip lift article lists numbness, stiffness, paresthesia, lip distortion, smile deformation, speech impediment, asymmetry, under-correction and visible or hypertrophic scarring among the reported complications of lip lift procedures generally, and singles out skin removal at or directly above the white roll as linked to unfavourable scarring [1].

A looksmax.org member who posted about their corner lip lift wrote that several surgeons had advised against it in order to preserve white lip length, but that they were pleased with the result and planned it as a proportion change before a custom jaw and chin implant [3]. Another thread shares a video describing the procedure and claims it widens the mouth by a couple of millimetres; a reply questions whether a wider mouth suits a narrow maxilla [4].

lore.intro: On looksmax.org the corner lip lift is discussed as a way to widen the mouth, add apparent lip size and adjust lower-third proportions, usually alongside other surgery [3][4].

claims.claim: A corner lip lift makes the mouth wider and lips look fuller.
claims.believers: A forum poster summarising a video says the procedure restructures muscles around the mouth and results in a wider mouth by a few millimetres [4].
claims.experts: No controlled study measuring mouth width after corner lip lift was found; the surgeon literature focuses on upper lip balance and vermilion exposure [2].

claims.claim: The procedure can be used to set new facial proportions before other surgery such as jaw or chin implants.
claims.believers: One member reports having it done first to establish new proportions before a planned custom jaw and chin implant, despite surgeons advising against it [3].
claims.experts: Surgeon-authored work describes lip lift design in terms of lip balance and facial harmony, but no study of sequencing with skeletal procedures was found [2].

claims.claim: Surgeons advise against the corner lift to protect white lip length, but some patients choose it anyway.
claims.believers: A member who had the procedure says several surgeons advised against it to preserve white lip length, yet they are satisfied with the result [3].
claims.experts: Wikipedia lists visible or hypertrophic scarring, lip distortion and smile deformation among documented complications of lip lifts [1]; no comparative study of patient satisfaction after corner lifts was found.
